name: I WILL DO IT SOON MAYBE LATER TOMORROW
source:
A short story about procrastination, family, and the inner dialogue of a creative person. A story about how delaying decisions slowly erodes a life.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4318400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个关于拖延、家庭和一个有创造力的人的内心对话的短篇故事。一个关于延迟决定如何慢慢侵蚀生活的故事。
